name: apana-plugin
description: The apana plugin for Claude Code: skills and hooks that do not call Jev.
author: Alexandru-Cristian Pana

scripts.test:claude-auto: (cd skills/install-claude-auto/assets && python3 -B -W ignore test_claude_auto.py && python3 -B -W ignore test_managed.py) && (cd skills/install-claude-auto/scripts && python3 -B -W ignore test_setup.py)
scripts.test:code-rag: python3 -B -W ignore -c "import sys, unittest; suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('skills/code-rag/scripts', pattern='test_*.py'); result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite); sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful() or bool(result.skipped) or result.testsRun == 0)"
